Sandbox_TWALT_GothStartKit: Give goth chest rigs at start
Sandbox_TWALT_GothStartKit_tooltip: GothBagTweaks: puts the goth chest rigs into a new character's inventory at spawn. A character created before this option existed is given them once on load. Master switch - turn it off to give nothing.
Sandbox_TWALT_GothStartKitFullTight_tool: Give Goth_ChestRigFull_Tight. Identical stats to the loose one, only the worn model differs (switch with the right-click menu). Not needed if you already take the loose one.
